basics.name: Christian Angelo Umali
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer & AI Engineer
basics.summary: Goes by Angelo Umali. Senior Software Engineer & AI Engineer with 9+ years shipping production web and mobile software for teams in six countries: Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Canada, the United States, and the Philippines. Founded ZKidz Dev LLC in 2020 and still writes the code on its builds. Has been building AI into products since 2025; in 2026 it became most of his work. Current main build is PropApp, an off-market property marketplace in Australia: web platform, iOS and Android apps, and AI features. Based in Manila, Philippines, and works remotely. Open to senior software engineering and AI engineering roles, and to selective client builds through ZKidz Dev.

work.name: ZKidz Dev LLC
work.summary: Owns architecture and delivery across the consultancy's client portfolio, and is lead implementer on its main builds. Clients span Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Canada, the United States, and the Philippines.
highlights: PropApp, current main build: the Next.js web platform, the vendor and agent mobile apps on React Native and Expo, and AI features including a buyer assistant and a brief builder.

Since March 2026, consulting for one of the largest lending institutions in the Philippines: building agentic AI software with their engineers, introducing pull-request review and QA automation with end-to-end tests, and running on-site workshops.
Sets the engineering standards every client engagement runs on, and owns architecture and trade-off decisions across the portfolio.

Built an agent-orchestration framework on top of Claude Code that routes work to 13 specialized agents and holds each task until its quality gates pass: format, lint, typecheck, tests, build, and a runtime smoke test.
Shipped AI features in eight products: PropApp, Kitna (ClearSpent), My Business Coach, Lead Nurture Agent, IdeaFlare, Agency Partner Hub, CrownOS, and PulseTrack.

work.name: ZKidz Dev LLC
work.summary: Consultancy run alongside two full-time roles, at Adaca and Blackpepper. Technical owner across 15+ production systems in e-commerce, real estate, sports tech, and print-on-demand.
highlights: Taply: architected a white-label e-commerce platform serving 1,000+ businesses across 300+ branded storefronts, at 300K monthly end users. Drove 23% user growth, cut support tickets 30%, and halved build time with an automated Fastlane pipeline.

Domain Project Sales (formerly realestateprojects.au): delivered five products: a public listings site, an agency and developer portal, a buyer app, an agent app, and a NestJS campaign API with Facebook and Google Ads integrations.
PICkle Book: led end-to-end development of the photo book app and its web admin: 50-page layouts, 50 concurrent image uploads, print-ready PDF export, and Stripe payments.
FTBLRLife: led delivery of the React Native sports social platform: real-time messaging, push notifications, video and media sharing, with CI/CD on Fastlane.
Urban.com.au: two mobile apps and a web platform. Image caching work reduced load times 40%, and automated deployments cut manual release effort 80%.

work.name: Blackpepper
work.summary: Built and maintained React Native e-commerce apps for Australian and New Zealand fashion brands.
highlights: Shipped and maintained 6 React Native e-commerce apps for Glassons, RedRat, and Hallensteins.
Rebuilt the release process on Fastlane and GitHub Actions, taking a release from 10 days to 4 (60% faster).

work.name: Adaca
work.summary: Built web and mobile products in React and React Native.
highlights: Delivered 7 products (4 mobile, 3 web), including real-time trading for the ShoreTrade fishery marketplace.
Cut bundle size 35% with code-splitting and tree-shaking.

work.name: Trends & Technologies
work.summary: Built full-stack web and mobile applications for client engagements.
highlights: Led a cross-functional team of five across parallel client engagements, delivering 7+ production projects.

projects.name: PropApp

Brief builder that analyses three homes a buyer loves and fills in their buying brief from schema-validated output.

A proposal step: nothing moves until the user approves it.

A discovery agent runs structured intake, then hands off to specialized coaches.

Alerts closers in Slack and runs personalized follow-up on cold leads.

references.name: Alain, CEO at Blackpepper
references.reference: Christian consistently delivered high-quality mobile applications that exceeded our expectations. His attention to detail and ability to work with cross-functional teams made him an invaluable team member.

references.name: David, Founder at FTBLRLIFE
references.reference: I have worked with Angelo for 3 years on a very big app project. He has worked on the front end, designs, as well as our service provider for digital asset management. The biggest benefit to hiring Angelo is he can solve any problem that comes up. Our app has messaging, a store, gamification, leaderboards, profiles, news etc. We are lucky to have found Angelo.

references.name: Hussam, Lead Engineer
references.reference: Christian played a crucial role in our success, deploying over 300 white-label storefronts. His ability to mentor junior developers while maintaining high code quality standards was remarkable.

references.name: Louis, Head of Product
references.reference: Angelo brings both technical expertise and business judgment to every project. He understands complex requirements and turns them into solutions that actually ship well.

references.name: Albert, Software Engineer at Blackpepper
references.reference: I highly recommend Angelo, my former colleague at Blackpepper NZ. Angelo consistently delivered high-quality mobile applications on time, showcasing his expertise in React Native and advanced technical skills.

references.name: Jaye, Software Engineer at Trends
references.reference: I worked with Angelo for several projects and he really is a reliable teammate. He always shares what he discovered from different technologies and helped raise our code standards.

references.name: Kyrie, Software Engineer at Trends
references.reference: I recommend Angelo as a Software Engineer. Besides his technical skills, he is a hardworking and dedicated professional who always delivers quality work.
